{{Quote|Artoo Deetoo, ''forget'' about tapping into the main computer system to locate ''hospital facilities'' for master Luke-- we're already ''doomed!''|C-3PO|<ref name="SW19" />}}
This '''hospital''' was located on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] space station.

==History==
The hospital staff included a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wheel doctor|doctor]]. [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was treated by her after the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] landed inside the Wheel.<ref name="SW19" /> The doctor was ordered to drug Luke Skywalker, but he was able to break free and escape.<ref name="SW20">[[Star Wars (1977) 20|''Star Wars'' (1977) 20]]</ref>
